name: Topotecan

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for blood problems and immune system problems

fda.text: MYELOSUPPRESSION Topotecan can cause severe myelosuppression. Administer first cycle only to patients with baseline neutrophil counts of greater than or equal to 1,500/mm 3 and platelet counts greater than or equal to 100,000/mm 3 . Monitor blood cell counts [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . WARNING:…

summary: Topotecan carries the FDA's strongest boxed warning in the United States for severe blood and immune system problems, specifically severe drops in blood cell counts known as myelosuppression [3][4]. The drug's label also warns about risks of severe tissue injury if it leaks from a vein, as well as interstitial lung disease, which is a lung condition that has caused fatal cases [4]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than tests on people estimated a high score for liver concerns and a low score for heart concerns [M].
